caseName: Iron Arrow Honor Society v. Schweiker
caseNameFull: Iron Arrow Honor Society v. Schweiker, Secretary of Health and Human Services

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of North Haven Board of Education v. Bell, 456 U. S. 512 (1982). Justice Brennan, Justice White, Justice Marshall, and Justice Blackmun dissent.
